newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Siemens bags 1.49 bln peso Manila contract.
newsitem.headline: Siemens bags 1.49 bln peso Manila contract.

text.p: MANILA, Reuter (Nov 13) - Siemens AG signed on Wednesday a 1.493 billion peso contract to put up a 230 kilovolt transmission line in northern Philippines for the National Power Corp (Napocor), Napocor President Guido Delgado said.

Delgado said the contract entails the construction of a 94.4 kilometer overhead transmission line system that will link Napocor's 600-megawatt Masinloc coal-fired power plant in the northern Zambales province to the grid.
The project is scheduled for completion within 20 months, Napocor said.
